info.name: PMS Data Sync – Projects & Customers
info.description:
Postman Collection v2.1 covering PMS Inbound Project Synchronization and Customer Management APIs.

All endpoints require Bearer API key authentication with the projects.write scope.

request.description: Atomically synchronizes one customer organization, customer contacts, and one or multiple projects (up to 50 per batch) with permanent entity mapping.
Partially update an existing project identified by its PMS project_code. Omitted fields retain existing values.
